name: opencircle
description: Repo-level dev tooling. The apps live in backend/ (npm) and frontend/ (pnpm).

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "BACKEND_API_URL=${BACKEND_API_URL:-http://localhost:3000} pnpm --dir frontend dev -p 3001"
